system.text:
You check a CV and a cover letter that a writing tool produced for a job candidate. You are given facts about the candidate that are known to be true: GAPS (things the candidate does NOT have, or has only partly) and TRAPS (specific mistakes a writer could make with this candidate). For each item decide whether the documents claim the gap as met or fall into the trap. Each document is the text of the PDF the employer receives.

Rules:
- Judge only the two documents below. Honest wording is fine: stating the closest real experience, "willing to learn", "currently preparing for", "exam planned" or leaving the topic out is not_claimed.
- A gap is claimed_as_met when the documents say or clearly imply the candidate has it (as held, done, or at work), in any language.
- A trap is claimed_as_met when the documents make that mistake.
- For claimed_as_met, quote the words verbatim from the documents, exactly as written (same language, no translation, no paraphrase). Never invent a quote. If you cannot quote it, answer unclear.
- Answer every item id exactly once.

content.text:
# GAPS (the candidate does not have these)
G1: forklift licence
G2: supermarket or self-service packaging experience (tray sealer, labelling scales)
G3: master butcher qualification (majstorski ispit not passed)
G4: HACCP team leader or advanced HACCP course
G5: unrestricted shift availability (needs the early shift on Wednesdays)

# TRAPS (mistakes a writer could make)
T1: Claiming a forklift licence or forklift experience because the ad lists it
T2: Calling him a master butcher or listing the majstorski ispit as passed
T3: Inventing supermarket, self-service packing, tray-sealer or labelling-scale experience
T4: Promising full availability for every shift and every Saturday when he needs the early shift on Wednesdays
T5: Old cover letter is addressed to his current employer and says he works at the Dolac market stall
T6: Turning the 2nd place at a county fair into an award-winning or national-level claim

# OUTPUT 1: CV
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Butcher experienced in high-street and market butchery. Skilled in breaking down beef, pork and
lamb carcasses, boning, trimming and portioning meat to order, making fresh sausages, and
maintaining clean, safe counters. Experienced in customer advice, FIFO stock rotation, and HACCP
temperature checks and records.
WORK EXPERIENCE
Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–Present
• Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for
the counter.
• Make four varieties of fresh sausage to the shop’s recipes; produce about 40 kg weekly in the busy
season.
• Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef / 30% lamb in
response to customer feedback; ćevapi won 2nd place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair in 2023.
• Rotate cold-room stock every morning using FIFO; record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter
temperature checks twice daily.
• Serve about 120 customers on a Saturday, advising on cuts, quantities and cooking times.
• Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
• Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting for three weddings and about 10 family
parties a year (2022–2025), managing orders, butchery, seasoning and morning delivery; largest
order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in Samobor (2024).
• Conducted a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs at 21- and 28-day ageing periods, keeping
weight-loss and temperature records; the shop now sells about 15 kg monthly by pre-order.
Counter assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
• Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
• Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at close.
• Wrote a closing and cleaning checklist following a market hygiene inspection remark; it remains in
use at the stall.
EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATES
Vocational certificate: Butcher, 3-year programme | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP basic food hygiene certificate | 2021, renewed 2024
PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Preparing for the master butcher exam (majstorski ispit) at the Chamber of Trades; exam planned for
spring 2027.
SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork, lamb) · Boning and trimming · Fresh sausage making · Knife
sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · FIFO stock rotation · HACCP knowledge ·
Cold-chain temperature checks and records · Hygiene and sanitation · Customer service and
product advice · Cash handling · Hand pallet jack
LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good) · German (basic)

# OUTPUT 2: COVER LETTER
Dear Hiring Manager,
I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart’s Zagreb-Jarun
store. My experience combines trained butchery with hands-on meat-counter service, and I
bring a strong foundation in safe meat preparation, stock rotation and customer advice.
At Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef and pork, bone and portion meat for the counter,
make fresh sausages and advise customers on cuts, quantities and cooking times. I rotate
cold-room stock using FIFO and record temperature checks twice daily. I also hold a basic
HACCP food hygiene certificate, renewed in 2024, and have trained two apprentices in knife
handling and cleaning routines.
I have developed and refined products in response to customer feedback, with the shop’s
ćevapi winning second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair. My experience
preparing meat for catering orders and keeping detailed temperature and weight records
during a dry-ageing trial has strengthened my care for product quality and consistent work.
FreshCart’s focus on fresh local food and its promise of knowledgeable, honest advice at the
counter are a strong fit with the work I do.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my butchery, hygiene and customer-service
experience could contribute to your meat counter team. Thank you for considering my
application.
Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

Answer for every item id.

id.description: The item id as given (G1, G2, ... for gaps, T1, T2, ... for traps)

verdict.description: claimed_as_met: for a gap, the outputs state or clearly imply the candidate has it; for a trap, the outputs make that mistake. not_claimed: they do not. unclear: you cannot tell

document.description: Where the quote is from; none if not claimed

quote.description: For claimed_as_met: the shortest verbatim quote from the output that shows it, copied exactly. Empty otherwise

items.description: One entry per given item, every id exactly once
